name: robot-wiki
description: An encyclopedic interactive guide to modern robotics for ML engineers

scripts.prebuild: node scripts/prune-next-type-duplicates.ts && node scripts/prune-generated-og-shadows.ts && npm run validate:content && npm run check:tektur-fonts && npm run check:og-renderer-fonts
scripts.build: next build && node scripts/measure-reading-times.ts && next build
scripts.build:ungated: npm run prebuild && npm run build --ignore-scripts
scripts.postbuild: node scripts/check-reading-times.ts && node scripts/prune-export-artifacts.ts && node scripts/patch-404-guard.ts && node scripts/build-search.ts && node scripts/lint-no-slop.ts && npm run check:brand-v2-registries && npm run check:brand-v2-enforcement && npm run generate:og-cards && npm run check:og-card-bytes
scripts.refresh:brand-v2-evidence: npm run generate:brand-v2-registries && npm run generate:og-cards && npm run build:ungated && node scripts/prune-export-artifacts.ts && npm run refresh:brand-v2-evidence:browser && npm run refresh:brand-v2-evidence:renderer-parity && npm run generate:brand-v2-enforcement
scripts.refresh:brand-v2-evidence:browser: playwright test --config playwright.brand-v2.config.ts tests/e2e/brand-v2-primitives.spec.ts tests/e2e/brand-v2.spec.ts tests/e2e/brand-v2-tektur-font-delivery.spec.ts tests/e2e/brand-v2-identity.spec.ts tests/e2e/brand-v2-shell.spec.ts tests/e2e/brand-v2-mobile-shell.spec.ts tests/e2e/brand-v2-article.spec.ts tests/e2e/brand-v2-home.spec.ts tests/e2e/brand-v2-home-tools.spec.ts
scripts.refresh:brand-v2-evidence:focused-mutati: playwright test --config playwright.brand-v2.config.ts tests/e2e/brand-v2-route-flows.spec.ts -g "rejects a route profile" --workers=1
scripts.validate:content: node scripts/validate-content.ts && node scripts/lint-no-slop.ts --source-only && node scripts/check-chart-descriptions.ts
